claims.statement: The PPWR entered into force in February 2025 and generally applies from 12 August 2026 across packaging regardless of material or origin.
The PPWR establishes recyclability grades and provides for producer-responsibility financial contributions to be modulated by those grades after the relevant delegated and implementing acts.

contrary_evidence: Key EU design-for-recycling criteria and fee-modulation details are still scheduled for later acts.
Producer-responsibility organisations and packaging PLM vendors may supply adjacent tools.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: a versioned cross-country rule graph linked to observed packaging-component classifications
fingerprint.customer: multi-SKU EU consumer brands and importers without enterprise packaging-data teams
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: packaging converters, design agencies, producer-responsibility advisers, and product-information systems
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: packaging BOM ledger, evidence collection, country reporting exports, and what-if fee/recyclability simulator
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: the producer pays per entity subscription and governed SKU change
fingerprint.problem_trigger: a packaging component, supplier, market, or sales volume changes and alters declarations, recyclability evidence, or EPR exposure

founder_fit: Uses FMCG familiarity, quantitative modelling, and automated document extraction; channel sales and a Polish-brand pilot minimise social load.
risks: A fee simulator can mislead if presented as an authoritative bill.
Country-specific reporting rules may outgrow a part-time founder.

structure.control_point: the approved packaging specification and producer-report dataset used before procurement and EPR filing
structure.critical_dependency: complete packaging BOMs plus authoritative, current national EPR fee and reporting rules

thesis: A SKU-level packaging ledger can join supplier specifications, national producer registrations, recyclability rules, and declared volumes, then show the compliance and fee effect before a packaging change is approved. Packaging suppliers and fractional sustainability teams provide one-to-many distribution; each SKU revision and reporting period renews demand.
title: Packaging Change-Control and EPR Fee Simulator for EU Brands
uncertainties: Near-term willingness to pay before later recyclability deadlines.
Access to current national fee schedules.
Whether converters will distribute a tool that can recommend material substitution.
